blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Long video understanding relies on video memory to overcome the context limits of multimodal large language models.
Existing methods follow a build-then-reasoning pipeline: memory is built offline for the entire video, then reasoned over as a static source.
In practice a long video is shared by several questions, and this pipeline is costly at both ends: with few questions, building memory for the whole video costs far more than answering them; with many questions, the memory is never updated, so what is learned while answering questions is lost to the next question.
To alleviate these, we introduce Sprout , an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning: a temporal tree that sprouts detailed nodes as questions are answered.
The agent watches the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, stopping when the current question can be answered, remembers each segment as a coarse node of the tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to refine the tree with the recovered details.
Once a segment is recorded as text, its video input is removed from the context history, while the original video remains reachable through the video tools.
The memory tree and prior question–answer records persist across questions, so the memory is online and dynamic: built from the first question onward and updated by every question thereafter.
We find that replacing accumulated video inputs with textual memory substantially reduces context usage while maintaining accuracy, with slight improvements in some settings.
Across benchmarks on three models, Sprout achieves competitive or improved accuracy relative to representative offline memory methods, with no upfront construction stage and lower context cost per question.
blocks.zh:
长时间的视频理解依赖于视频内存来克服多式联运大语言模型的背景限制.
现有方法遵循一个构建时合理的管道:内存是整个视频的线下构建的,然后作为静态源进行推理.
在实践中,一个长的视频被几个问题共享,这个管道在两端都是成本高昂的:几乎没有问题,建立整个视频的内存成本远远超出回答这些问题的成本;在很多问题中,内存从未更新,因此在回答问题时学到的东西会输给下一个问题.
为了缓解这些现象,我们引入了Sprout ——一种在推理的同时建立记忆的代理框架:一种在回答问题时发出详细节点的时间树.
代理以低帧速率逐段观看视频段,当当前问题可以解答时停止,记得每个段是树的粗节点,并以更高的帧速率重新检查密钥间隔,以用回收的细节来细化树.
一旦一个片段被记录为文本,其视频输入就会从上下文历史中删除,而原始视频仍然可以通过视频工具实现.
内存树和先前的问答记录贯穿所有问题,因此内存是在线和动态的:从第一个问题开始构建,然后由每个问题更新。
我们发现,用文字内存取代累积的视频输入,大大减少了上下文的使用,同时保持准确性,有些设置略有改进.
从三个模型的基准来看,Sprout相对于有代表性的离线内存方法而言,实现了竞争性的或更高的准确性,没有前期建设阶段,每个问题的背景成本较低.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Google DeepMind, 2026 ; Keye Team, 2026 ) have extended video understanding from short clips to long recordings spanning hours, such as lectures, films, and days of egocentric activity ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
Answering questions about such videos requires locating brief moments scattered across time and connecting the evidence among them.
As duration grows, however, feeding the video directly into the model becomes infeasible: the number of visual tokens scales linearly with length and quickly exceeds what a context window can hold.
Sampling more sparsely fits the budget but discards the brief moments that questions often hinge on, while sampling more densely preserves them at a cost the context cannot absorb.
Long video understanding therefore relies on video memory : a representation of the video maintained outside the context, from which question-relevant content is retrieved when needed.
blocks.zh:
多式联运大语言模型的进展 (Quen Team,2026年;Google DeepMind,2026年;Keye Team,2026年) 将视频理解从短片段扩展至长时间的录音,如讲座,电影,以及以自我为中心的活动日(Fu等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a;杨等人,2025年).
回答有关这些视频的问题需要找到分散在不同时间的短暂瞬间,并将其中的证据联系起来。
然而,随着持续时间的增长,将视频直接输入模型变得不可行:可视符号的数量随长度而线性地缩放,并迅速超过上下文窗口所能持有的东西.
抽样比较稀少地符合预算,但忽略了问题往往所依赖的短暂时刻,而抽样更密集地保存了它们,代价是背景无法承受。
因此,长时间的视频理解依赖于视频内存:在上下文之外保持视频的表示,在需要时从中检索与问题有关的内容。

blocks.en:
Existing methods ( QwenLM, 2026 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) construct video memory through a build-then-reasoning pipeline (Figure 1 a): they first build memory offline , then reason over the resulting static memory with an agentic framework.
In the construction stage, the model processes the entire video without knowing future questions and stores it as persistent memory; In the reasoning stage, it retrieves relevant evidence from that memory to answer a given question.
Prior work within this pipeline mainly differs in how the offline memory is organized. Hierarchical memories ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) recursively summarize short segments into multi-scale representations, enabling top-down retrieval from coarse summaries to fine segments. Graph-based memories ( Long et al., 2026a ; Yeo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; QwenLM, 2026 ) model relations among events, entities, and time, answering questions through navigation and traversal over the resulting structure. Flat episodic memories ( Choi et al., 2026 ) keep construction minimal by indexing clip captions with multiple retrieval keys and deferring semantic composition to inference time. Despite these differences, all share two properties. First, memory is built offline over the entire video before answering, requiring costly conversion of fine-grained details into memory. Second, memory is static: it is only read during inference and not updated, so the model’s observations and conclusions cannot persist across questions.
In practice, a long video may be used to answer anywhere from a single question to a dozen or more. This leaves offline, static memory limited at both extremes: 1) upfront construction is wasteful when few questions are asked, since it must record every segment regardless of what is eventually asked; 2) a non-updatable memory prevents useful information from accumulating when many questions are asked, forcing each question to recover the same evidence from scratch.
blocks.zh:
现有方法(QuenLM, 2026; Choi 等人, 2026 )通过一个构建时合理的管道构建视频内存(图1a):它们首先在线下构建内存,然后用代理框架对由此产生的静态内存进行解释.
在构建阶段,模型在不知道未来问题的情况下处理整个视频,并将其存储为持久的内存; 在推理阶段,它从该内存中获取相关证据以回答某个问题.
这个管道内以前的工作主要在离线内存的组织方式上有所不同. 分级记忆(Yang等人,2025年;Tian等人,2025年) 递归性地将短段归纳为多尺度的表示,使从粗小摘要到细小部分的自上而下检索成为可能. 基于图表的记忆(Long等人,2026a); Yeo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; QuenLM, 2026 ) 事件,实体和时间之间的示范关系,通过导航和绕过由此产生的结构回答问题. 平坦的零星记忆(Choi et al., 2026)通过将带有多个检索密钥的剪辑标题索引,将语义成分推迟到推论时间来保持最小的构造. 尽管存在这些差异,但都拥有两个属性. 首先,在回答之前,整个视频的内存是线下构建的,需要将精细细节转换成内存的成本高昂. 其次,记忆是静态的:它只在推论中读取,没有更新,因此模型的观察和结论不能贯穿所有的问题.
在实践中,长视频可能用于回答从一个问题到十几个以上的任何地方. 在两个极端, 静态内存都受到限制: 1) 前置构造在问问题很少时是浪费的,因为它无论最终问到什么,都必须记录每个部分;2)当问到很多问题时,一个不可更新的内存会阻碍有用的信息积累,迫使每个问题从头收回相同的证据.

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we propose a new framework whose memory is built while reasoning rather than before it, following two principles.
First, the memory is built online from what the model has watched: rather than recording every segment in advance, it grows as the model watches for each question, so no cost is paid for video that no question needs.
Second, the memory is refined from coarse to fine: it starts as brief summaries of what happens in each segment, and whenever the model looks closer at a segment to answer a question, it adds the details it finds.
blocks.zh:
为了消除这些局限性,我们提出了一个新的框架,其记忆是在推理的同时建立起来的,而不是在两个原则的基础上建立起来的。
首先,内存是在线从模型所看到的:而不是预先录制每个片段,而是随着模型观察每个问题而增长,因此不需要为不需要质疑的视频支付费用.
第二,内存从粗细细细细细细细细细化:它开始作为每个片段所发生的事情的简要总结,每当模型更接近一个片段来回答一个问题时,它会增加它发现的细节.

blocks.en:
Based on the build-while-reasoning framework, we introduce Sprout , an agentic framework whose memory is a temporal tree that sprouts new nodes as questions are answered (Figure 1 c), built through three actions: watch , remember , and revisit . Watch. Given a question, the agent streams the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, starting from the beginning of videos or where the memory left off, and stops once it judges that the segments the question needs have been found. Remember. As each segment is watched, the agent writes it into memory as a coarse node with a time interval and an event summary, forming the first level of a temporal tree.
Once a segment is recorded, its video input is removed from the context history, allowing the agent to reason without that video chunk and greatly reducing context pressure. Revisit. When a retrieved node identifies a relevant video interval but lacks the needed detail, the agent revisits it at a higher frame rate, saves the recovered details as child nodes, and may search memory for related earlier information. The revisited frames are released from the context history in the same way.
blocks.zh:
基于构建与合理框架, 我们引入了 Sprout, 一种代理框架, 它的内存是一个时间树, 看着 考虑到一个问题,代理以较低的帧率逐段流出视频段,从视频开始或内存离开的地方开始,一旦判断问题需要的片段已经找到就停止. 记住 随着每个片段被监视,代理将其写成粗细的节点,带有时间间隔和事件摘要,形成时间树的一级.
一旦一个片段被录制下来,它的视频输入就会从上下文历史中移除,使代理商可以在没有该视频块的情况下进行推理,并大大降低上下文压力. 复问. 当一个检索到的节点识别出一个相关的视频间隔但缺乏所需的细节时,代理以更高的帧率重访,将回收到的细节保存为子节点,并可能搜索存储器以获取相关的早期信息. 重新审视的框架以同样方式从上下文历史中释放出来。

blocks.en:
Together, the three actions follow the two principles above.
Watching and remembering build the memory online from the video the model has actually watched, and keep text rather than video in the context.
Revisiting refines coarse nodes into finer ones while the model reasons.
As a result, our memory is online and dynamic : it is built online after the first question arrives, even when the full video is available in advance, and it keeps growing as each question adds nodes, refines existing ones, and leaves its answer behind.
blocks.zh:
三项行动共同遵循上述两项原则。
观看和记忆从模型实际观看的视频上在线构建内存,并在上下文中保留文本而不是视频.
重审将粗结点精炼成细结点,而模型则有其原因.
因此,我们的记忆是在线的和动态的:它是在第一个问题到达后在线建造的,即使整个视频是提前提供的,随着每个问题添加节点,完善现有的节点,并留下答案,它也不断增长.

blocks.en:
We evaluate Sprout with three models (GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , Qwen3.8-Max, and Gemini 3.8 Flash) on LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , Video-MME Long ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , and Video-Holmes ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) .
Its accuracy is competitive with or better than representative offline memory methods, while it pays no construction cost before the first question.
It also uses fewer tokens (Figure 1 b): with Gemini 3.8 Flash, it spends 71.7K and 99.3K tokens per question on LVBench and Video-MME Long, 74% and 55% fewer than direct inference.
blocks.zh:
我们用三种模型(GPT-5(OpenAI,2025年),Quen3.8-Max和双子座3.8 Flash)评价LV Bench(Wang等人,2025年a),Video-MME 长(傅等,2025年),和视频-霍尔姆斯(程等,2026年).
其准确性与代表性的离线内存方法相比具有竞争力或更好,而在第一个问题之前则不支付任何建造费用.
它也使用更少的符号(图1b):与双子座3.8 Flash,它在LV Bench和Video-MME Long的每个问题上花费了71.7K和99.3K的令牌,比直接推论少了74%和55%.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: • We identify two limitations of the build-then-reasoning pipeline: offline construction is wasteful for few-question videos, and static memory cannot accumulate insights from earlier reasoning. • We propose Sprout, an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning through three actions: it watches the video at a low frame rate, remembers each segment as a coarse node of a temporal tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to add finer nodes. • We further find that removing video frames from the context once they are recorded as text keeps the context small without reducing accuracy. Experiments with three models on benchmarks show that Sprout is more effective than an offline memory method.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献有三个方面: 我们找出了建设时合理管道的两个局限性:线下建设对于几个问题视频来说是浪费的,静态记忆不能从早期的推理中积累洞察力. 我们提议Sprout是一个代理框架,通过三个动作建立内存同时进行推理:它以低帧速率观看视频,记得每个片段是一个时空树的粗节点,以更高的帧速率重新审视密钥间隔,以添加更细节点. ^ 我们还发现,视频帧一旦被记录为文本,就从上下文中去除,使上下文保持小幅而不降低准确性。 在基准上有三个模型的实验表明,斯普鲁特比离线内存方法更有效.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Agentic Multimodal Reasoning. Rather than answering from what is already in the context, agentic multimodal methods call external tools during reasoning to gather the evidence they need.
MM-REACT routes a language model to vision experts through a textual interface ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , while ViperGPT composes visual and language modules into executable programs ( Surís et al., 2023 ) .
For video, VideoAgent iteratively gathers relevant visual information under the control of an LLM ( Wang et al., 2024 ) .
DrVideo converts video into a coarse textual document and augments selected entries with additional visual information as its agent searches for missing evidence ( Ma et al., 2025 ) .
More recently, VideoSeek provides overview, skim, and focus tools, allowing an agent to adapt its inspection granularity while reasoning over accumulated conversation history ( Lin et al., 2026a ) .
VideoSearcher instead trains the tool-invocation policy itself with reinforcement learning, unifying temporal localization, spatial focusing, and external multimodal search for open-world video questions ( Gao et al., 2026 ) .
These methods show that tool use during reasoning can improve multimodal performance.
More broadly, reliable multimodal reasoning rests on grounding outputs in explicit visual evidence: models comprehend relations among objects ( Li et al., 2026 ) , keep interleaved image–text content coherent ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , suppress hallucinations unsupported by the image ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , and ground reward judgments in fine-grained, region-level visual evidence ( Long et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026a ) .
Sprout connects this tool use to persistent memory management: each inspection updates a temporal node, its video inputs can then leave the context history, and the recorded information remains available to subsequent questions.
blocks.zh:
代理式多式联运理由。 代理式多式联运方法不是从上下文中作出回答,而是在推理时使用外部工具来收集它们所需要的证据。
MM-REACT通过文字界面(Yang等人,2023年)向视觉专家传递语言模型,而ViperGPT则将视觉和语言模块编译成可执行程序(Surís等人,2023年).
对于视频,VideoAgent迭代收集受LLM控制的相关视觉信息(Wang等人,2024年).
DrVideo将视频转换成粗糙的文本文档,并增加一些附加视觉信息的条目,作为代理搜索缺失证据(Ma等人,2025年).
最近,VideoSeek提供了概览、滑动和焦点工具,使代理商能够调整其检查颗粒性,同时对累积的对话历史进行推理(Lin等人,2026a) 。 。 。
VideoSearcher则通过强化学习、统一时间定位、空间重点和外部多模式搜索开放世界视频问题(Gao et al., 2026)来培训工具调用政策本身。
这些方法表明,在推理时使用工具可以提高多式联运的性能。
更广义地说,可靠的多式联运推理基于以明确的视觉证据为依据的输出:模型理解物体之间的关系(Li等人,2026年),保持图像内容的互离一致性(Chen等人,2025年a),抑制图像不支持的幻觉(Chen等人,2025年b),以及区域层面的视觉证据中的地面奖励判决(Long等人,2026年b;Yang等人,2026年b;Yang等人,2026年a)。
Sprout将这个工具的使用与持续的内存管理连接起来:每次检查都更新一个时间节点,其视频输入随后可以离开上下文历史,录制的信息仍然可供以后的问题使用.

blocks.en:
Efficient Long Video Understanding. Long video understanding requires balancing temporal coverage, visual detail, and input cost, as reflected in Video-MME, LVBench, and EgoLife ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
One direction expands the amount of visual information a model can process: LongVILA combines context extension, long-video instruction tuning, and sequence parallelism to support longer video inputs ( Chen et al., 2025c ) , and Keye-VL-2.0 adapts sparse attention to a multimodal backbone to process hour-level videos within a 256K-token context ( Keye Team, 2026 ) .
Another direction reduces the representation size: LongVU adaptively compresses spatial and temporal visual tokens to fit long videos within a limited context ( Shen et al., 2025a ) .
At inference time, VideoTree allocates representation detail according to query relevance through adaptive expansion of a video tree ( Wang et al., 2025b ) .
Together, these approaches improve the trade-off between coverage and detail through model capacity, compression, or evidence selection.
Our focus is how observation density and retained context evolve over an answering session.
Sprout first builds coarse temporal nodes from low-frame-rate observations, then revisits relevant intervals at higher frame rates and writes the recovered details back to those nodes.
Textual memory carries these observations into later reasoning steps, allowing the corresponding visual inputs to be released from the context history while the source video remains accessible.
blocks.zh:
高效长视频理解. 长时间的视频理解需要平衡时间覆盖、视觉细节和输入成本,这反映在Video-MME、LV Bench和EgoLife(Fu等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a); 杨等,2025).
一个方向可以扩大一个模型可以处理的视觉信息的数量: LongVILA结合了上下文扩展,长视频指令调和,序列并行主义支持较长的视频输入(Chen等人,2025c),Keye-VL-2.0对多式联运主干线的注意很少,在256K-token背景下处理小时级视频(Keye Team,2026).
另一个方向缩小了表示大小:LongVU适应性地压缩空间和时间视觉符号,以适应有限背景下的长视频(Shen等人,2025a). 。 。 。
推论时间,视频 树通过视频树的适应性扩展,根据查询的相关性分配表现细节(Wang等人,2025b) 。 。 。
这些办法通过模型能力、压缩或证据选择,共同改善覆盖面和细节之间的权衡。
我们的重点是观察密度和保留上下文如何在回答时演变。
Sprout首先从低帧率观测中建立粗糙的时间节点,然后以更高的帧率重新审视相关间隔,并将回收的细节写回这些节点.
文字内存将这些观察带入后来的推理步骤中,使得相应的视觉输入能够从上下文历史中释放出来,而源视频仍然可以访问.

blocks.en:
Video Memory and Retrieval. Long-video methods keep a memory outside the context and answer by retrieving from it.
This memory follows a build-then-reasoning pipeline: it is built before any question, in one pass or incrementally as the video arrives, and it stays static while questions are answered.
Streaming methods such as MA-LMM and M3-Agent are the incremental case: their memory grows as frames arrive, but it is still formed without questions and only read at answer time ( He et al., 2024 ; Long et al., 2026a ) .
Within this pipeline, methods differ in how the memory is organized.
Hierarchical memories summarize segments at multiple temporal scales and answer by top-down retrieval ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) .
Graph-based memories link events, entities, and time, then answer by search or traversal: WorldMM, MemDreamer, and Qwen-MM-Plugins retrieve over multi-scale or hierarchical graphs ( Yeo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; QwenLM, 2026 ) ; Vgent and EGAgent add verification or entity search on the graph ( Shen et al., 2025b ; Rege et al., 2026 ) ; HippoMM consolidates short-term observations into longer-term memory ( Lin et al., 2026b ) .
MERIT keeps the memory flat, indexing clip captions under multiple keys and assembling evidence at inference time ( Choi et al., 2026 ) .
Caption-based methods such as LLoVi, Video-RAG, and iRAG let the question decide which text is fetched or refined ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Arefeen et al., 2024 ) .
Sprout builds the memory while reasoning, adding and refining nodes only where questions lead and keeping those nodes and earlier answers for later questions.
blocks.zh:
视频记忆与检索. 长视频方法将一个内存保存在上下文之外,并通过从中检索来回答.
这种记忆遵循的是一条构建时的理性管道:它是在任何问题之前建造的,在视频到达时以一个通道或递增的方式通过,在回答问题时保持静态.
MA-LMM和M3-Agent等流化方法是递增的案例:它们的内存随着帧的到来而增长,但是它仍然是在没有疑问的情况下形成的,只在回答时间才被读取(He等人,2024年;Long等人,2026年a). 。 。 。
在这个管道中,存储器的组织方法不同.
分级记忆在多个时间尺度上总结段段,通过自上而下的检索回答(Yang等人,2025年;Tian等人,2025年).
基于图表的记忆将事件、实体和时间联系起来,然后通过搜索或转录来回答:WorldMM、MemDreamer和Qun-MM-Plugins在多尺度或分级图表中检索(Yeo等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;QuenLM,2026年);Vgent和EGAgent在图表中增加了核查或实体搜索(Shen等人,2025年b; Rege等人,2026年;Hippo MM将短期观测整合为长期记忆(Lin等人,2026b.
MERIT将内存保持平坦,在多个密钥下索引剪辑标题,并在推论时收集证据(Choi等人,2026年)。
LLoVi, Video-RAG, iRAG 等基于标题的方法让问题来决定获取或完善哪个文本(Zhang等人,2024年;Lo等人,2025年;Arefeen等人,2024年).
斯普鲁特在建立记忆的同时,推理,添加和精炼的节点只存在于问题引领的地方,并保留这些节点以及更早的后期问题的答案.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Pipeline of Sprout. Three questions about one video are answered in order, building one memory.
Each row shows the rounds of one question: tool calls (circles) and their results (boxes).
Video frames stay in the context for one round only; text results are kept. Q1 watches the first two chunks, remembers them as coarse nodes, and revisits n 2 n_{2} at a higher frame rate to add finer child nodes. Q2 reuses the memory: search returns a node and Q1’s answer, and a short revisit adds one more detail, without watching new video. Q3 finds that the memory does not cover what it asks, so it watches two more chunks.
The last two chunks are never watched.
The memory tree (bottom) is drawn on the same time axis as the video; node colors show which question added each node.
blocks.zh:
图 2:斯普鲁特的管道. 三个关于一个视频的问题按顺序回答,构建一个记忆.
每行显示一个问题的回合:工具调用(circles)及其结果(boxes).
视频帧只保留上下文一回合;文本结果保留. Q1观察前两个块,记得它们为粗结节点,并以更高的帧率重访n 2 n_{2}添加更细的子节点. Q2重用内存:搜索返回一个节点和Q1的答案,简短的重访会增加一个细节,而不看新视频. Q3发现内存没有覆盖它所要求的内容,因此它还要观察两个块.
后两块从不看。
内存树(底层)与视频在同一时间轴上绘制;节点颜色显示哪个问题添加了每个节点.

blocks.en:
In this section, we present Sprout, an agentic framework that builds video memory while reasoning.
Unlike build-then-reasoning methods, which construct memory over the entire video before any question arrives, Sprout starts from an empty memory and builds it only while answering questions.
Given a video V V of duration T T and questions q 1 , … , q K q_{1},\ldots,q_{K} about it, the model answers each question over multiple rounds, calling tools (Appendix A ) that perform three actions: watch attaches the next unwatched chunk of the video at a low frame rate, remember writes it into memory as text, and revisit watches a recorded interval again at a higher frame rate to add details.
The memory is shared by all questions about the video, so later questions can reuse what earlier ones have built.
Figure 2 illustrates this process on three questions.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们介绍了Sprout,一种在推理的同时构建视频内存的代理框架.
与构建-当时的理性方法不同,这种方法在任何问题到来之前将内存构建在整个视频上,斯普鲁特从一个空的内存开始,只在回答问题时构建它.
鉴于T T 的视频 V 和问题 q 1,..., q K q_{1},\ldots,q_{K } 关于它,模型在多个回合中回答每个问题,调用工具(Appendix A ) 进行三个动作:表以低帧速率附下一段未观察的视频块,记住把它写成内存作为文本,再用更高的帧速率再次观看一个录制的间隔以添加细节.
内存被所有关于视频的问题所分享,因此以后的问题可以重复早期的问题所构建的东西.
图2在三个问题上说明了这一进程。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dynamic Temporal Memory
blocks.zh: 3.1 动态时间记忆

blocks.en: The memory has three parts: a temporal tree of observations, a watch record of how far the video has been watched, and a question history of earlier questions and their answers.
blocks.zh: 记忆有三部分:一棵观察时间树,一张观看录像的纪录,以及早期问答的问世史.

blocks.en:
Temporal tree. The tree is organized by time.
Its root spans the whole video [ 0 , T ] [0,T] .
Every other node covers an interval [ s i , e i ] ⊆ [ 0 , T ] [s_{i},e_{i}]\subseteq[0,T] and stores an event summary, observed facts, and key entities for that interval; the children of a node split its interval into shorter pieces in temporal order.
Because each node keeps its interval, the video behind any node can be watched again.
The tree grows with the three actions: watching and remembering add coarse nodes under the root in temporal order, and revisiting adds children under a node where a question needs more detail.
At any moment, the tree is therefore deep only where questions have looked closely, and it ends where the unwatched video begins.
Nodes store only what was observed in the video; questions and answers are kept in the question history, so that the nodes remain useful to unrelated later questions.
blocks.zh:
临时树. 树依时组织.
其根横跨整个视频[0,T][0,T].
每个其他节点覆盖一个间隔[s i , e i]... [s_{i}, e_{i}]\subseteq [0, T] 并存储一个事件摘要,观测到的事实,以及该间隔的关键实体;一个节点的子孙按时间顺序将其间隔分成较短的块.
由于每个节点保持间隔,任何节点背后的视频都可以再次观看.
树与三个动作一起生长:观看和记忆在根下按时间顺序加粗结点,再看会在一个需要更详细提问的节点下增加孩子.
因此,无论何时,这棵树只有在问题已经仔细观察的地方才很深,它结束于未观看的视频开始的地方.
节点只存储视频中观察到的东西;问答保留在提问历史中,这样节点仍然对后来无关的问题有用.

blocks.en:
Access. The model does not see the tree directly.
Its context holds the current question, the watch record, and a compact list of the question history; the content of the tree is reached only through search (Section 3.4 ).
All writes go through tools that check the new nodes against the current tree, so that at every level the tree stays in chronological order within the watched video.
blocks.zh:
进入。 模型不直接看到树.
它的背景是当前的问题、观察记录和问题历史的紧凑清单;树的内容只有通过搜索才能达到(第3.4节)。
所有写作都通过工具来检查新节点与当前树的对比,这样在每个关卡上,树都按时间顺序留在被观看的视频中.

blocks.en: 3.2 Watch: Coarse Temporal Exploration
blocks.zh: 3.2 观察:粗糙的时空勘探

blocks.en:
The agent watches new video with read_next , either when the memory is empty, as at the first question, or when the memory does not yet cover what the question asks about.
The tool takes no arguments: the runtime selects the next unwatched chunk from the watch record and attaches its frames at a low rate f c f_{\mathrm{c}} , together with the speaker-labelled transcript of the chunk when audio is available.
At this rate, the agent learns what happens and when at a small visual cost.
blocks.zh:
代理用 read_next 观看新视频, 要么是当内存是空的, 如第一个问题时, 要么是当内存还没有覆盖提问的内容时 。
工具不取参数:运行时间从手表记录中选择下一个未观察的块,并以低速f f = f_{\mathrm{c}}} 附加其帧,同时在音频可用时附加该块的标有扬声器标记的记录.
以这种速度,代理能以微小的视觉成本来学习发生和发生的事情.

blocks.en:
How far to watch is decided by the current question.
After each chunk is remembered (Section 3.3 ), the agent has three options: watch the next chunk, revisit an interval that looks relevant, or answer.
Watching can therefore stop before the end of the video, and dense revisits can already happen during the first question.
Everything watched stays in memory for later questions.
blocks.zh:
眼下的问题决定了看多远.
在每个块被记住后(第3.3节),代理有三种选择:观察下一个块,重温一个看起来相关的间隔,或者回答.
因此,观看可以在视频结束前停止,在第一个问题期间,密集的重访可能已经发生.
观察的一切都是为了以后的问题

blocks.en: 3.3 Remember: Recording Observations and Releasing Frames
blocks.zh: 3.3 记住:记录观察和释放框架

blocks.en:
Each watched chunk is written into memory right away.
After read_next , the chunk is pending : the agent must store it with write_chunk_memory in the next round before it can watch another chunk.
The call passes a list of segments, each with an interval, a summary, and a set of facts.
The runtime appends them as coarse nodes under the root and advances the watch record to the end of the chunk.
The agent is instructed to write about 4–8 segments per chunk with 5–10 objective facts each, and to record only what is in the video, never the question, its options, or its reasoning.
blocks.zh:
每个被监视的块被写进记忆中
在读取后_ next 时, 块正在等待 : 代理在下一轮中必须用 write_ chunk_memory 存储, 才能看到另一个块 。
电话通过各段的列表,每段有间隔,摘要,以及一组事实.
运行时间将它们作为粗结点附加在根下,并将表记录推进到块尾.
该代理被指示每块写大约4-8个片段,每个片段都有5-10个客观事实,并且只记录视频中的内容,从不记录问题,其选项,或其推理.

blocks.en:
Releasing frames. Once the model has responded to a chunk, its frames are removed from the context history before the next model call; the textual tool results and the model’s responses are kept.
Frames therefore never pile up in the context: each chunk costs one call with frames and one text-only call to store it.
Frames from revisits are removed in the same way.
blocks.zh:
释框. 一旦模型响应了一个块,它的帧会在下一个模型调用之前从上下文历史中删除;文本工具结果和模型的响应保留下来.
因此,框架从不堆积在上下文中:每个块都花费一个有框架的呼叫和一个只使用文本的呼叫来存储.
重新审视时的帧以同样方式被移除.

blocks.en:
To see the saving, consider t t observations with v 1 , … , v t v_{1},\ldots,v_{t} visual tokens and a textual context of length B t B_{t} .
Keeping all frames and releasing them after use give context lengths L t retain = B t + ∑ j = 1 t v j , L t release = B t + v t . L_{t}^{\mathrm{retain}}=B_{t}+\sum_{j=1}^{t}v_{j},\qquad L_{t}^{\mathrm{release}}=B_{t}+v_{t}. (1) Each observation is still paid for once, but only the latest one stays in the context.
blocks.zh:
要看到保存, 请考虑 t t 观察 v 1, ... ..., v v v {1},\ ldots,v_{t} 视觉符号和文字上的长度 B t B_{t} 。
保留所有帧并在使用后释放它们 给上下文长度 L t 保留 = B t + ∑ j = 1 t v j, L t 释放 = B t + v t. (原始内容存档于2018-09-25) (中文(简体) ). L_{t}^{\mathrm{ retain}}=B_{t}+\sum_{j=1}^{t}v_{j},\qquad (原始内容存档于2018-09-29). L_{t}^{\mathrm{ release}}=B_{t}+v_{t}. (1) 每项观察仍付一次,但只有最新的一次留在上下文中。

blocks.en: 3.4 Revisit: Retrieval, Dense Inspection, and Write-Back
blocks.zh: 3.4 检索:检索、强化检查和回写

blocks.en:
Revisiting lets the agent return to video it has already watched.
It has three steps: retrieve relevant nodes from the memory, watch their intervals at a higher frame rate, and write new details back.
blocks.zh:
重审让特工回到已经观看的视频中.
它有三个步骤:从内存中取回相关的节点,以更高的帧速率观察它们的间隔,以及写回新的细节.

blocks.en:
Retrieval. Since the model does not see the tree, it searches the memory with search_memory , which returns text only.
A query is a set of literal, case-insensitive alternatives (e.g., "vest | waistcoat" ), a time window, or both; a window alone returns everything stored in that span (Appendix B compares this literal matching with embedding retrieval).
The result lists the matching facts with their timestamps under their nodes, followed by entries of the question history whose question mentions the query, so earlier answers come back together with the observations behind them.
The agent is instructed to search before answering detail questions, and the number of searches per question is capped.
blocks.zh:
寻取. 由于模型没有看到树,它用搜索_memory 搜索内存,只返回文本.
一个查询是一组字面的,对大小写不敏感的替代品(如"vest QQ腰衣"),一个时间窗口,或者两者兼而有之;一个窗口单独返回存储在该跨度内的一切(附录B比较这种字面匹配与嵌入式检索).
结果列出了与其节点下的时间戳相匹配的事实,然后是问题历史的条目,其中的问题提到了查询,所以早先的答案与后面的观察结果一起回来.
特务在回答细节问题前被指示搜索,每题搜索次数封顶.

blocks.en:
Dense inspection. When a retrieved node points to the right event but lacks the detail the question needs, the agent watches that part of the video again. view_node attaches the whole interval of a node, and view_time attaches an explicit interval inside the watched video, which the runtime clamps to the node that contains it.
Both tools take a focus describing what to look for and a frame rate f r > f c f_{\mathrm{r}}>f_{\mathrm{c}} chosen by the agent, so dense frames are spent only on the chosen interval.
This can reveal brief events or intermediate actions missed at the low rate.
blocks.zh:
强化检查。 当一个检索到的节点指向正确的事件但缺乏问题需要的细节时,代理再次观看了视频的这一部分. view_node 附加一个节点的整个间隔,而view_time 附加了被观看的视频内部一个明确的间隔,运行时夹住包含它的节点.
两种工具都以一个焦点来描述要寻找什么,以及一个帧率 f r > f c f mathrm{r}}>f_{\ mathrm{c}}} 由代理所选择,所以密框只用于所选择的间隔.
这可能揭示出以低速率错过的短暂事件或中间行动。

blocks.en:
Write-back. Each inspection tool is paired with a write-back tool that accepts only the interval just viewed. refine_node splits the node just viewed with view_node into contiguous children in temporal order that cover its interval.
This is allowed only for a leaf, so an internal node can serve as evidence but its subtree is never rewritten. add_observation stores a summary and facts for the interval just viewed with view_time as a child of the node.
In both cases, the parent keeps its description, so coarse context and new detail are kept side by side, and the revisited frames are removed as in Section 3.3 .
If the evidence is still not enough, the agent can search again, revisit other nodes, or watch more video.
A question ends when the model calls answer or reaches the maximum number of rounds, in which case it must answer with the evidence it has.
blocks.zh:
写回. 每个检查工具都配有只接受刚刚查看的间隔的回写工具。 精炼_ 节点将刚刚以视图_ 节点查看的节点分割成毗连的子节点, 以时间顺序覆盖其间隔 。
这只允许叶子,所以内部节点可以作为证据,但其子树从未被重写. 添加_observation 存储节点子时正视的间隔摘要和事实。
在这两种情况下,父母都保持其描述,因此粗糙的上下文和新的细节并存,重新审视的框像第3.3节一样被删除.
如果证据仍然不够,代理商可以再次搜索,重新查看其他节点,或者观看更多的视频.
当模型调用答案或达到弹数上限时,一个问题就结束,在这种情况下它必须用它掌握的证据来回答.

blocks.en: 3.5 Accumulation Across Questions
blocks.zh: 3.5 跨问题累积

blocks.en:
After a question is answered, the tree and the watch record are kept for the next question.
The answer call also appends the question, its options, and the predicted answer to the question history; later questions see these entries in compact form and can retrieve them with search_memory .
A new question therefore starts from everything earlier questions have built: it can reuse existing nodes, refine them, or extend the tree into unwatched video.
Since all watching and writing happens while questions are answered, the memory covers only what the questions have needed, and each question pays only for the video and detail it adds.
blocks.zh:
在回答一个问题后,树和表记录被保存下来,作为下一个问题.
答案调用还附加了问题,其选项,以及对问题历史的预测解答;后来的问题以紧凑的形式看到这些条目,并可以通过搜索_memory 检索.
因此,一个新问题从先前的问题所构建的一切开始:它可以重新使用已有的节点,对其进行精炼,或者将树伸展为无观察的视频.
由于所有观看和写作都是在回答问题时发生的,故记忆只涵盖问题所需要的内容,每个问题只支付其添加的视频和细节.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Benchmarks and metric. We evaluate on three complementary benchmarks: LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025a ) contains 1,549 questions over 103 hour-scale videos; the Long subset of Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) contains 900 questions over 300 videos lasting 30–60 minutes; and Video-Holmes ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) contains 1,837 questions over 270 short suspense videos, emphasizing reasoning across scattered visual clues.
We also evaluate on EgoLifeQA ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , using the 500 questions of one participant (Jake) over a 44.3-hour recording spanning seven days.
With hundreds of questions about the same recording, it tests how well the memory is reused.
Table 1 reports the first three benchmarks and Table 2 reports EgoLifeQA.
blocks.zh:
基准和衡量标准。 我们用三个互补的基准来评价:LV Bench(王等人,2025年a)包含超过103小时尺度的视频的1,549个问题;Video-MME的长子集(傅等人,2025年)包含超过300个持续30-60分钟的视频的900个问题;Video-Holmes(程等人,2026年)包含超过270个短暂悬念视频的1,837个问题,强调跨越分散的视觉线索的推理.
我们还利用一位参与者(Jake)的500个问题,用长达7天的44.3小时录音,对EgoLifeQA(Yang等人,2025年)进行评估。
与数百个关于同一录音的问题,它测试记忆的再利用程度.
表1报告了前三个基准,表2报告了EgoLifeQA。

blocks.en:
Implementation. We run Sprout with three models: GPT-5, Qwen3.8-Max, and Gemini 3.8 Flash.
The memory starts empty for each video and is kept across its questions.
Questions arrive one at a time; the agent sees its own earlier answers, but not the ground truth or future questions.
On LVBench and Video-MME Long, read_next attaches 10-minute chunks at f c = 0.1 f_{\mathrm{c}}=0.1 fps; GPT-5 uses 5-minute chunks at the same rate to fit the image limit of its endpoint.
On Video-Holmes, chunks are 30 seconds long at f c = 1 f_{\mathrm{c}}=1 fps.
Revisits choose f r ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 } f_{\mathrm{r}}\in\{1,2,4,8\} fps and attach at most 768, 48, and 2,048 frames per view for Qwen3.8-Max, GPT-5, and Gemini, respectively.
For comparison, Direct gives Qwen3.8-Max up to 768 sampled frames on Video-MME Long and 1 fps on Video-Holmes, and gives Gemini up to 3,072 frames.
Each question may use at most 32 rounds .
An ASR transcript is attached to each chunk on Video-MME Long, but not on LVBench or Video-Holmes.
As described in Section 3.1 , the model does not see the tree: its context shows only the watch record and the question history, and the tree is reached through search_memory .
We call this setting the progress exposure .
For Qwen-MM-Plugins, the memory is built once by Qwen3.7-Plus and shared by all three models.
blocks.zh:
执行。 我们以三种模式运行Sprout:GPT-5,Quen3.8-Max,和双子座3.8 Flash.
每段视频的内存开始为空,并贯穿其提问。

blocks.en:
As described in Section 3.3 , Sprout releases frames from the context once they have been recorded as text.
We now examine how this affects accuracy and the context window, with Gemini 3.8 Flash as the model.
Since Sprout answers a question over multiple rounds, its context size changes from round to round (Figure 3 a): a round that carries frames uses more tokens than the rounds after it, so the last round is not necessarily the one with the most tokens.
We therefore take the peak context size over all rounds of a question as its context window, and report the mean and maximum of this value over all questions.
blocks.zh:
如第3.3节所述, " 发芽 " 框架一旦被记录为文字,就从上下文中释放出来。
我们现在研究这如何影响准确性和上下文窗口,以双子座3.8 Flash为模型.
由于Sprout在多个回合中回答一个问题,其上下文大小从回合变为回合(图3 a):一个带框的回合比之后的回合使用更多的符号,所以最后一轮不一定是最有符号的回合.
因此,我们把一个问题所有回合的顶端上下文大小作为上下文窗口,并报告在所有问题上这一价值的平均值和最大值。

blocks.en:
Releasing frames. Figure 3 b shows that releasing frames does not hurt accuracy.
We compare Sprout with a variant w/o releasing frames , which keeps every frame in the context until the question ends.
Keeping frames enlarges the context window by up to 4.3 × \times . Yet accuracy does not improve.
The variant revisits less often because old frames remain visible, but what these frames provide is already recorded in memory or can be recovered by a revisit.
blocks.zh:
释框. 图3b显示,放出帧不影响准确性.
我们比较Sprout和变体w/o释放帧, 它将每个帧都放在上下文中直到问题结束。
保持帧可以将上下文窗口扩大最多4.3×\时 。 然而,准确性并没有提高。
变体的重现次数较少,因为旧框仍然可见,但这些框所提供的已经记录在内存中,或者可以通过重现来恢复.

blocks.en:
Context window. Releasing frames also keeps the context small throughout a question, as shown in Figure 3 c.
Direct places the whole sampled video in a single request of more than 200K tokens.
Qwen-MM-Plugins keeps all retrieved text and frames across rounds, so its context grows as a question proceeds, and its largest question approaches the size of Direct.
In contrast, Sprout watches each video segment only once and then removes it from the context history.
Its mean window is similar to that of Qwen-MM-Plugins, but its largest window is several times smaller and stays below 55K tokens on both benchmarks.
Therefore, recording each observation as text and releasing its frames keeps the context small without losing accuracy.
blocks.zh:
上下文窗口。 如图3c所示,放任框还在整个问题中保持上下文小。
直接将整个采样视频放入超过200K令牌的单一请求中.
Quen-MM-Plugins将所有检索到的文本和框架保存到各轮,因此其上下文随着提问的进行而增长,其最大的问题接近Direct的大小.

因此,将每项观察记录为文字并放出其框架保持上下文小而不失去准确性。

blocks.en:
We next measure the total tokens a question uses over all its rounds, with Gemini 3.8 Flash (Table 4 ); for Qwen-MM-Plugins, we add its offline construction cost, spread over the questions of each benchmark.
Sprout uses 74% and 55% fewer tokens than Direct on LVBench and Video-MME Long, since it watches each segment only once at a low frame rate and revisits only the intervals a question needs.
Qwen-MM-Plugins answers with about as many tokens as Sprout, but it pays for construction no matter how many questions a video receives: on Video-MME Long, with only 3 questions per video, construction alone costs 210K tokens per question and pushes the total above Direct.
In contrast, Sprout builds memory only as questions arrive, so its total cost is the lowest on both benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来用双子座3.8 Flash(表4)测量一个问题在所有回合中使用的总符号;对于Quen-MM-Plugins,我们加上它的离线建造成本,并分布在每个基准的问题上。
Sprout在LV Bench和Video-MME Long上比Direct使用74%和55%的代币,因为它只以低帧率观看每个段一次,只重温一个问题需要的间隔.
Quen-MM-Plugins以与Sprout差不多的代币回答,但无论视频收到多少问题,它都支付建造费用:在Video-MME Long上,每段视频只有3个问题,单是建造就每个问题花费210K代币,推总比直接要高.
相比之下,斯普鲁特只在问题到来时才建立内存,因此其总成本在两个基准上都是最低的.

blocks.en: 4.5 Effect of the Question History
blocks.zh: 4.5 问题历史的影响

blocks.en:
Sprout keeps the questions of a video and its own answers in the question history, which later questions can see.
To test whether this history helps on its own, we separate it from the memory tree (Table 4 ): Direct answers each question independently, while Causal answers the questions of a video in order and shows each later question the earlier questions, reasoning, and answers as text.
Although these earlier answers may be wrong, Causal does not hurt accuracy.
On Video-Holmes, where questions about one video build on the same clues, accuracy improves by 3.9 points; on LVBench and Video-MME Long, where questions are largely unrelated, the differences stay within 1 point.
Earlier answers thus help when questions share content and do no harm otherwise, so keeping the question history is worth its small text cost.
blocks.zh:
斯普鲁特在问题史上保留了一段视频中的问题和自己的答案,后来的问题可以看见.
为了检验这个历史本身是否有帮助, 我们把它和记忆树分开(表4): 直接独立地回答每个问题,而Causal则按顺序回答一个视频的问题,并显示后来的每一个问题,推理,以及作为文本的答案来质疑之前的问题.
尽管这些早期的答案可能是错误的,但Causal并不伤害准确性.
在Video-Holmes上,关于一个视频的问题建立在相同的线索上,准确度提高了3.9分;在LV Bench和Video-MME Long上,问题基本无关,差异在1分以内.
先前的答案因此有助于当问题分享内容而不会造成任何伤害时,因此保留问题的历史值得付出小的文本成本.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Sprout, an agentic framework that builds video memory while reasoning instead of before it.
The agent watches the video in coarse chunks, remembers each chunk as a node of a temporal tree, and revisits the intervals a question needs at a higher frame rate, writing the recovered details back into the tree.
Frames are released once they are recorded as text, and the tree and the question–answer records persist across questions, so the memory is built from the first question onward and refined by every question thereafter.
Across three benchmarks and three models, Sprout matches or exceeds offline memory methods without an upfront construction stage, keeps the context window bounded by a single observation, and spends fewer tokens per question on long videos.
Our experiments also show that releasing frames after use costs no accuracy and that earlier answers help later questions when they share content.
Future work includes richer retrieval over the tree, such as multi-key indexing, and mechanisms for merging or forgetting nodes, which the current memory, like existing offline memories, does not have.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Sprout, 一种代理框架, 建立视频记忆 同时推理而不是之前。
代理以粗细块观看视频,记得每个块是时空树的节点,并以更高的帧率重新审视一个问题需要的间隔,将回收的细节写回树上.
框架一旦被记录为文字,就释放出来,树和问答记录在各种问题中持续存在,因此记忆从第一个问题开始,然后由每个问题加以完善。
横跨三个基准和三个模型,Sprout匹配或超越了没有前期构建阶段的离线内存方法,将上下文窗口以单个观察为界,每个问题在长视频上花费的符号较少.
我们的实验还表明,使用后释放帧成本不准确,更早的答案有助于日后分享内容时的提问.
未来的工作包括更丰富的在树上的检索,如多键索引,以及合并或忘记节点的机制,当前内存和现有的离线记忆一样,没有这样的机制.

blocks.en: Appendix B Literal Matching versus Embedding Retrieval
blocks.zh: 附录B 嵌入检索

blocks.en: Sprout and Qwen-MM-Plugins both let the agent search a textual memory, but they match queries to memory in different ways.
blocks.zh: Sprout和Quen-MM-Plugins都让代理搜索一个文本内存,但他们以不同的方式将查询与内存匹配.

blocks.en:
How each method searches. In Sprout, search_memory uses literal matching.
A query is a list of alternatives separated by “ | | ”, and a fact matches if it contains any alternative as a case-insensitive substring; an optional time window restricts the search to one span.
The tool returns every matching fact in temporal order under its node, up to 40 facts, followed by up to five earlier questions that mention the query.
Qwen-MM-Plugins uses embedding retrieval.
When its memory is built, every node of the graph is encoded by a text embedding model ( qwen3-vl-embedding ).
At query time, the query is encoded by the same model, nodes are ranked by cosine similarity and by BM25, the two rankings are fused, and the top 10 nodes are returned.
blocks.zh:
每种方法如何搜索。 在Sprout中,Search_memory使用字面匹配.
一个查询是用“ QQ QQ ” 分隔的选项列表, 如果它包含任何选项作为对大小写不敏感的子字符串, 则是一个事实匹配; 一个可选的时间窗口将搜索限制在一个时长 。
该工具在其节点下按时间顺序返回每个匹配的事实,最多40个事实,随后最多还有5个先前提到查询的问题.
Quen-MM-Plugins使用嵌入式检索.
其内存建成后,图形的每一个节点都由一个文本嵌入模型(qwen3-vl-embedding )编码.
在查询时间,查询由同一模式编码,节点按余弦相似度排名,按BM25排序,两个排名合并,返回前十名节点.

blocks.en:
Why literal matching is enough. Current agent models are already strong at searching: they can choose keywords, list synonyms in one query, as in "vest | waistcoat | tank top" , and rewrite the query when a search returns nothing.
With such an agent, simple literal matching finds the facts it needs, so Sprout does not rely on an extra text embedding model.
This saves both time and tokens.
In Qwen-MM-Plugins, embedding the nodes alone costs 7.5M, 7.9M, and 1.1M tokens of construction on LVBench, Video-MME Long, and Video-Holmes, and every search waits for one more call to the embedding model.
Literal matching instead runs directly on the current memory tree, with no embedding cost and no index to rebuild when new nodes are written.
blocks.zh:
为什么字面匹配就够了. 目前的代理模型在搜索时已经很强:它们可以选择关键词,在一个查询中列出同义词,如"vest QQ腰衣QQ坦克顶部"中,当搜索返回无任何结果时重写查询.
有了这样的代理,简单的字面匹配就能找到它需要的事实,因此Sprout不依赖额外的文本嵌入模型.
这既节省了时间,也节省了象征。
在Quen-MM-Plugins中,仅嵌入节点就花费了7.5M,7.9M,以及1.1M的建造符号在LV Bench,Video-MME Long,和Video-Holmes上,每次搜索都等待着再次呼叫嵌入模型.
字面匹配则直接运行在当前的内存树上,没有嵌入成本,也没有索引在新节点被写入时重建.

blocks.en:
Comparison. To compare the two directly, we replace literal matching in search_memory with embedding retrieval, using the same text embedding model as Qwen-MM-Plugins, and keep everything else unchanged.
Table 6 reports the results with Qwen3.8-Max.
The two perform within one point of each other: literal matching is 0.8 and 0.4 points higher on LVBench and Video-MME Long, and embedding retrieval is 0.5 points higher on Video-Holmes.
Literal matching therefore gives similar accuracy without the cost of an embedding model.

blocks.en: ⬇ You are a multimodal agent answering a multiple - choice question about one long video while building and maintaining a reusable memory tree of it . You act only by calling the provided tools , and you finish by calling answer . You read the video yourself in chronological chunks . read_next attaches the next unread chunk ’ s frames at the streaming fps ( READ_FPS ); on your next turn you store the complete chunk with write_chunk_memory , and then read on , inspect , or answer . At the very first question of a video the memory is empty and everything is unread , so your only useful first call is read_next ; while unread video remains , keep reading if unseen content could change the answer — especially for whole - video questions . The streaming fps is low , so brief motion , transient on - screen text , fine action order , and exact counts may be missing from memory even when the surrounding events are recorded . Recover those inside the read prefix with view_time on a tight interval at a higher fps , or view_node on a node ; what you see is stored only if you call add_observation ( after view_time ) or refine_node ( after view_node of a leaf ). You do NOT receive the memory tree — not even its outline . MEMORY_PROGRESS reports only how far the video is read ( read_until ) and what remains unread ; missing memory after read_until means unread video , not absent content . Everything read so far is stored as segments and retrieved on demand with search_memory . Work from evidence , not from guesses : probe the memory before answering — several literal alternatives in one pattern ( synonyms , the option texts , names , on - screen words ), a time window when the question pins one down , and different phrasings when the first finds nothing . Memory holds objective , reusable video facts only — named identities with distinguishing attributes , exact counts , temporal order and state changes , cause - to - consequence pairs , notable dialogue or on - screen text — never the question , the options , your reasoning , or your answer . Segments are chronological , contiguous , and non - overlapping , with meaningful event boundaries ; the runtime assigns node IDs , so never invent them . PRIOR_QUESTIONS lists earlier questions already answered for this same video with the answer you chose ; search_memory also returns prior answers whose question mentions the pattern . Use them as cross - question context : keep answers consistent with established narrative understanding . They are NOT objective video facts and must never be written into memory . Timestamps are global HH : MM : SS clock strings ( e . g . ”01:11:36”); always write all three fields , never ”11:36” or ”1:11:36”. Inspecting one clip does not imply the question is ready to answer : re - evaluate after every clip and do not guess . Call answer only when the accumulated evidence distinguishes one option .
